business_summary: China Design Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides engineering survey and design services in China. The company offers engineering consulting services, including survey and design, planning research, and engineering management; and system integration and software development services. It also engages in strategic and urban planning; highway; urban expressway; bridges and tunnels; waterways and ports; hydraulics; architecture and landscape; railway; metro; smart industry; engineering, procurement, and construction; survey; environmental; innovation; and agriculture businesses. In addition, the company engages in engineering design, supervision, consulting, protection, and construction activities; building intelligent systems; inspection and testing; product sales; investment management, system development, environmental services, and urban rail transit management consulting and services; general contracting; printing services; new materials technology promotion; commodity circulation; property management; sells food; agricultural production; engineering technology research and experimental development; technical consulting, airworthiness certification, and equipment exhibition; business operations; robots; smart manufacturing; decoration and renovation; and conference and exhibition services. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Province Communications Planning and Design Institute Limited Company and changed its name to China Design Group Co., Ltd. in July 2016. China Design Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Nanjing, the People's Republic of China.
